scope: Verify provenance and remove the legacy no-digest exception for seven existing textbook images, without changing image bytes or chapter text.

review.method: Each distributed figure was compared using cmp with the original course/author asset. SHA-256 binds the matching bytes. For pinned repositories the license was verified at the same commit. For Alammar and Google the author page provides the applicable license; URL plus the observed digest records these unversioned originals.
review.excluded: CS231n opt1.gif is an exact match but the saddle-point animation is credited to Alec Radford at https://ruder.io/optimizing-gradient-descent/. The course's MIT license is not treated as the license for that animation. No separate rights confirmation was established.
review.publicNotices: The CS231n, micrograd, and Harvard license notices match the pinned upstream files. The Hugging Face image dataset card declares Apache-2.0; the reused full public notice matches the canonical Apache Foundation license text.
review.verification: Root build: 2077 pages, zero broken internal routes or files. Output: 291 passed; publication: 769 passed and 13 skipped; evidence: 588 passed. Checked the delivered bytes on all seven routes in both readers, and 28 browser figure loads at 1280 and 375 px. Whole-textbook scan: 1181 matching local digests, 37 unpinned paths, 10 external images, and zero mismatches, unregistered paths or KaTeX errors.
review.status: Local only, not pushed or deployed.
